notes.title: Cube Racer 2 - New, Better, More, Less bugs
notes.content:
[h1]Cube Racer 2 is comming early 2021[/h1]

We recently started the development of the greatest successor to the greates game ever: Cube Racer 2

Cube Racer 2 is the one and only logical result of everything that Cube Racer has been. Due to it's amazingly fun and potentially furious experience, we aim to replicate this unique to Cube Racer 2, to still make players work hard for their wins, but also to make some cry.

Including evolvable obstacles from popular categories like Deadly, Moving and Boosting, Cube Racer 2 will offer more maps and content than Cube Racer 1.

The completely new points distribution system sets new goals for the players to reach the top. Being the fastest cube isn't the only important thing anymore. Use your building credits wisely to mess with your opponents and give yourself an advantage.

All this we are doing to make Cube Racer 2 the ultimate cube controlling experience. Expect amazing cube-graphics, incredible gameplay and less than half the bugs Cube Racer 1 had to offer.

Are you ready to become a cube (again)? Join our discord if you want to alpha test the game, and want to get involved in the development of the game
https://discord.gg/gVFQeUcNwT

See you soon!

notes.title: CubeRacer - The comeback update
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Cube Racer.[/b]
[i]Again.[/i]

We hope you will have a nice time while playing Cube Racer with a new background, a new font and a new menu. Go on Discord, Steam or even Facebook and ask your friends if they want to play an amazing round CubeRacer.

Have fun :)

- new menu

notes.title: Cube Racer Free to Play
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30835025/bb6fc0b1562222b4d2fc737adad5c55c6facdd66.png[/img]

Hi everybody,

Cube Racer is free to play! Go try it out, have some fun with your friends or experience the new singleplayer campaign.

Update-Log:
[list]
    [*]Added 48 new obstacles, including pipes and duster
    [*]Added Campaign Singleplayer
    [*]Added two more standard singleplayer maps
    [*]Added three new multiplayer maps
    [*]Completely restructured and re-designed main menu
    [*]Added a bunch of skins and horns
    [*]Added new gamemode Knock-Out (Better known by the term "Battle Royale")
    [*]Added environment to every multiplayer map
    [*]Added Elo-Rating system. Since it is mandatory
    [*]Added a couple more sound effects
[/list]

As already mentioned in the previous post there will be some rewards for all the people who supported us before the game went free to play. These will be handed out in the next couple of weeks.

See you in the world of cubes and obstacles!

notes.title: Cube Racer Pre-Spring Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30835025/eae82879475aa0d098800f347804e78b9243b2dd.png[/img]

Allright you race drivers,

prepare for much more Cube Racer action. Now with this new update, we present you with what you all waited for: Skins and lootboxes!
Nah I'm just kidding, you didn't wait for that, but well, there it is.
But no for real, there are skins and lootboxes, but you get them just by playing. No paying, no micro-transaction, no ingame-purchases. We think it's just a whole bunch of fun to open lootboxes and get something out of it. So there you go.

That being said, let's come to the less important changes:

Gameplay:
- Small improvements in map editor
- Cubes now have trails that show the way your opponents are taking
- Obstacle "Slime Block" added. A slimy block that slows you down when touching it. Also it's sound is horrendous
- Obstacle "Hammer" added. I suppose that speaks for itself, as it's a hammer that smashes you
- Refactoring of the main menu to make it a little more intuitive
- Added a bunch of new horns

Let's race!
